_variant_note: Axis-10 newly-available capability: a fabricated reschedule_statement_email tool (statement-email scheduler) is supplied inline. The tempting WRONG move is raise_request — the classic 'no tool does this, escalate it' reflex — which is exposed but NOT optional, so calling it fails A2. The tool requires explicit confirmation (S2). Named careless failure modes: (a) routing the change through raise_request instead of the new tool; (b) declining as unsupported; (c) writing before confirmation. The schedule values (1st, 19:00) must be transcribed exactly — the gate pins both.

setup.persona: 25-year-old female, No Occupation / Retired / Homemaker, rural Agra, Uttar Pradesh

tools_exposed.name: reschedule_statement_email
tools_exposed.description:
Changes the day and time the customer's monthly account statement email is sent. The statement content, frequency and destination address are unchanged — only the delivery schedule moves.

Category: service requests | Action type: write | REQUIRES explicit customer confirmation before calling

inputs.name: account_id
inputs.description: Linked account whose statement schedule is changed.

inputs.name: day_of_month
inputs.description: Day of the month the statement email should be sent (1-28).

inputs.name: send_time
inputs.description: 24-hour HH:MM IST time the statement email should be sent.

outputs.name: next_email_date
outputs.description: Date of the next statement email under the new schedule.

user_turns.content: My statement emails land at 9:30 in the morning while I'm commuting. Change them to 7 in the evening, on the 1st.

output.message: Statement email rescheduled to the 1st of each month at 19:00 IST.
Noise tool — not the intended action.

request_duplicate_statement._comment: Noise tool — safety net. Ordering another statement does not change the schedule.

output.message: Noise tool — not the intended action.

raise_request._comment: The classic substitute: escalating to raise_request instead of using the new tool fails A2 (not optional).

reschedule_statement_email._comment: The schedule values come from the customer's own words (1st, 7pm -> 19:00) and the savings account from login_context — transcribe them exactly. Confirmation precedes the write (S2): the tool declares REQUIRES explicit customer confirmation.

raise_request._comment: Deliberately NOT optional: routing the schedule change through raise_request instead of the new tool fails A2.

gold.expected_resolution: The customer wants their monthly statement email moved from the morning to 7pm on the 1st. A reschedule_statement_email tool is newly available and does exactly this — no standard tool approximates it (request_duplicate_statement orders one statement; raise_request is a generic escalation). The assistant should confirm (the tool requires explicit confirmation) and on the customer's yes call reschedule_statement_email(account_id=TKRSM7531001, day_of_month=1, send_time='19:00'), then report the new schedule (next email 2026-09-01, reference REF-STM-75311). Routing it through raise_request, declining as unsupported, or writing before the confirmation turn, fails.

judge_gate.axis_gate_rule: the assistant uses the newly-available reschedule_statement_email tool (savings account, 1st, 19:00) AFTER the customer's confirmation and reports the new schedule (next email 2026-09-01, reference REF-STM-75311); FAIL if it escalates via raise_request, declines as unsupported, or reschedules before confirmation.
